headline: Foreign Portfolio Investors: KYC copy certification process simplified. | Foreign Portfolio Investors: KYC copy certification process simplified.
summary: The Reserve Bank of India has simplified compliance for foreign portfolio investors. Indian banks can now accept certain documents certified by authorized officials abroad.
why: Foreign portfolio investors are overseas funds that buy Indian stocks and bonds, so onboarding rules affect how easily capital enters the market. The Reserve Bank of India is the country's central bank and market regulator.
